subject: SolarWind Systems — Procurement sprint & marketplace private offer timeline
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
To: Alicia Rivera <alicia.rivera@solarwind.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: SolarWind — Procurement sprint & marketplace private offer timeline

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for taking the call today. Per our discussion, I attached a first-pass mutual action plan (SolarWind_MAP_v1.xlsx) with a proposed evaluation cadence and a target close window. High-level:

- 2-week POC starting as soon as we have account access (performance & latency targets outlined in tab "POC KPIs").
- Security & compliance swimlane: SOC 2 attestation, network architecture (VPC peering options), and audit log export.
- Procurement path: preference for AWS Marketplace Private Offer (PO) to leverage consolidated billing, but we can accept direct invoicing if needed — noted both options.
- Proposed business close: commit by Friday, July 26, to hit a mid-August production rollout.

Ask: can you confirm procurement owner, preferred billing path (Marketplace vs direct invoicing), and whether your legal team will sign via DocuSign or require an on-paper PO? I can follow up with our pricing/finance doc and a short billing flow summary.

I attached the MAP workbook and a short evaluation checklist so we can lock dates quickly. If AWS Private Offer is the route, please share the Seller ID or let me know and I can generate the offer draft.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri_yom@redwood.inference | +1-415-555-0189

Attachments: SolarWind_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Alicia Rivera <alicia.rivera@solarwind.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Greene <tom.greene@solarwind.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Jul 2028 09:10:12 -0400
Subject: Re: SolarWind — Procurement sprint & marketplace private offer timeline

Priyom,

Appreciate the MAP — looks actionable. I attached our RFP and a draft PO template so our procurement/legal team can compare. A few notes/questions from procurement:

- Billing: our preference is Marketplace Private Offer (AWS) to centralize spend, but we need to see the invoice flow to our AP team (SolarWind Inc; remit-to details in the RFP).
- Security: please provide SOC 2 Type II report and any penetration test summary; our security team will run a short questionnaire next week.
- Contracting: we typically sign DocuSign for SaaS buys. Can you prepare a DocuSign-ready PO and indicate who will be the signatory on Redwood's side?
- Timeline: procurement is aiming to complete commercial review by 7/18 so finance can approve by 7/20. Can you commit to turnaround on the PO by then?

I'll loop in Procurement Ops (procurement@solarwind.ai) for any billing/PO specifics. Tom is on the technical side and will coordinate the POC access.

Thanks — attaching: SolarWind_RFP_2028.pdf, SolarWind_PO_DocuSign.pdf

— Alicia
Head of Procurement | SolarWind Systems
Alicia.Rivera@solarwind.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 8 Jul 2028 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: SolarWind — Procurement sprint & marketplace private offer timeline

Thanks for forwarding, Priyom — answered inline plus next steps for internal owners.

- Marketplace Private Offer: acceptable. Procurement can accept an AWS Private Offer; finance will need the Marketplace offer ID and the commitment terms (start/end, renewal). If SolarWind wants consolidated AWS billing, they will be invoiced by AWS and we will receive settlement per AWS terms. Alternative is direct invoicing from Redwood (net-30). Please confirm which option SolarWind prefers; Alicia already indicated Marketplace is preferred.

- DocuSign PO: Karthik, can you generate a DocuSign-ready PO using the commercial terms in RDW-2028-1457? Legal will take a 24–48 hour review. I put a short response template in the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-solarwind-maps (see file procurement_response.docx).

- Provisioning: if we commit to a Dedicated pool, ops needs a 7 business-day lead to reserve GPU capacity. POC can run on hosted instances immediately; Dedicated to follow post-signature.

Internal links: HubSpot deal HS-34721 (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-34721).

Priyom — please prepare: 1) final pricing attachment that matches the PO, 2) a one-page billing flow diagram for AWS Private Offer, and 3) SOC 2 Type II link (or packaged report) for Alicia. I can shepherd legal/finance for a fast review once those are in.

— Lauren
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Greene <tom.greene@solarwind.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>, Alicia Rivera <alicia.rivera@solarwind.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@solarwind.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jul 2028 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SolarWind — Procurement sprint & marketplace private offer timeline

Priyom / Alicia,

Quick confirmation from engineering: we can start the POC environment on Monday as proposed. Procurement has penciled in internal sign-off the week of 7/18 and will route the DocuSign PO to your legal signatory. Two asks for your side so we can keep to the timeline:

1) Final pricing breakdown (line items for compute vs inference units) so finance can map to our budget lines.
2) Billing contact and invoice remit-to for AWS Marketplace (if you choose Private Offer).

If you can get those by EOD 7/13 we should be able to meet the sign-by-7/18 target.

Thanks — Tom
Senior Engineering Manager | SolarWind Systems
